messages:
sam: Heads up — saw some weird billing attributions when API keys created via console are used by org-level service accounts. Example: request with header `X-Origin-Project` missing falls back to org owner instead of project. Anyone seen this?

maya: yep, repro. I think it's due to proxy authz returning only `org_id` for console-created keys. Token exchange path strips project claim.

liam: Is this only for legacy SA keys? New ephemeral tokens include project claims.

rachel: We route by `effective_project` when present, else `origin_project` -> else org. The ambiguity is between origin header vs SA-claim. We should prefer SA-claim if key is a service account key.

sam: Proposal: change routing priority to: `token.claim.project` -> `header.origin_project` -> org.default_project mapping. Also require telemetry event `auth.attribution.decision` with fields: reason, chosen_project, alternatives.

maya: :+1: but will that break quotas? Need migration plan + console UX: show 'assumed project' on key creation so owners know how attributions will resolve.

liam: Also add a canary flag: `auth.routing.experimental_v2` for 2 weeks. We'll add telemetry counters and a dashboard panel `Auth Attribution: decision tree`.

rachel: Need to update quota billing to tag events with `claimed_by` for retrospective billing. Edge case: impersonation tokens where `sub` != `iss` — we should surface that in telemetry as `auth.attribution.mismatch`.

sam: Draft config snippet to gate behavior:

```
auth:
  routing:
    priority:
      - token_claim_project
      - origin_header
      - org_default
  telemetry:
    emit_decision_event: true

```

maya: Can we include a deprecation window? i.e., keep the old fallback for 30 days and auto-switch after telemetry hits threshold (error/fallback rate < 0.5%).

liam: I'll add logs to `auth-proxy` and create Grafana panels. Also will add an SLA check to ensure fallbacks don't spike p95 latency.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `auth-proxy-canary` -> prod-canary on 2024-05-10 22:00 UTC.

sam: Action items: liam -> dashboard + canary rollout plan; maya -> console UX change to show assumed project; rachel -> update quota/billing tagging; sam -> RFC & changelog. Agree?

maya: :thumbsup:

rachel: one more: add unit test in authz for missing project claim and verify routing priority.

liam: I'll open a PR and tag this thread: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-proxy/pull/1234

sam: Thanks all. We should reconvene after 48h of canary telemetry.
